content: Pol no moni Jerusalem huuru wogunga manona bona ono wane waha bona lena.

Ariya ji elebe tere Itou nomo fai-aita Jerusalem langa yafade waha moni nigei nomo komo wagu ganga onoya waha boni letigini. Ji haruwe beha onowei nomo jala nere Galesia prowins nomo sios abitimu nigeneha, tere fere onowou wahanga ono wagu.

Tere bori oruwanga langa tere etenga-etenga bori waha gama langa maiboya moni teyaha waha wese wagu, onodu bonade ulate tere tage tebere mata langa tafadenga inyona, ono wadenga moni no edo menanga baingaro heigonbona. Ono wonga saini ji mai heigoni waha, tere moni nere nigei nomo ada kuru wagu ganga.
Saini ji mai tere bagu heigehenga tere tagewe fai ila hangada nigadenga, nere tere tebere toota waha tedu bode Jerusalem goyodbode. Ji nere pas nigidu boni huuru nigehenga goyodbode.
Onodu hilobainga ji yage fere goyei nomo ninafe isei mata woni wa, nere edo ji ngate gaara goyoboya.
Pol no Korin goi nerigona onowai.
Ji amugedu goi nere ila Masedonia prowins langa yafade waha nerigedu boni, iinga gonga ji mai tere bagu heigonboni.

Onodu boni ji tere bagu menanga yafoni rute. Ji alai uwa, ji tere bagu yafa gehenga goi oto saini bagu jagui anyakaro nomo saini bagu usu wona rute. Onodu saini ji matane ete langa goyoni ono gehenga, tere ji goyei nomo edo langa hoyo hiyagu ganga.
Ji tere bagu saini tutu menanga yafei nomo gau hiyei uwa. Anyakaro no ji awa hiyei mata wonga, ji tere bagu saini menanga ufaro yafonboni.
Onou wa ji Efesus taon beenga yafa gehenga Pentikos nomo fati heigonbona,
taate bona, Itou no ji jala amina faasu hayaha, waha boni ji nere fai-aita baingaro hoyo nigehenga Kristen heigodbode haruwe anyakaro inyina. Onodu fere, nere fai baingaro ere bode honggoro bagu.
Timoti no tere bagu heigei mata wonga, no tere gama langa huwanya foinga inyi gonga yafei nomo bonade hoyo tuwagu, no adai umugou. Tere isagu. No Anyakaro nomo haruwe tetena, ji yage ononi dorofe.

Gamaji tebereha ila nere no dada ewe dorofe uredu bode moge tuwogoga. Saini no tere awa tigona ono gonga tere no hoyo tubonade huwanya foinga inyou langa awa tuwadenga ege gidu ji bagu edo mayonbona. Ji no baabo gane bagu gaara mayei nomo itari tuni.

Onodu ere ebere baige Apolos nomo beele waha nu benou. Ji saini baingaro no baabo gane ila bagu gaara, saini nere goi tere terigei nomo boni beele danga bagu letuwene. Ariya no elebe mayei nomo awadena. Iinga no nogo isidu mayei nomo saini hilobainga tuwei mata wonga no mayonbona.
Ege beele ila.
Tere oofade bonade huwanyatege ngalengawou langa danga bagu oto wagu. Tere danga bagu yafa bonade, dada ete bonade adai umugagu.
Onodu tere tebere huwnyatege Itou tubonade nere fai nigagu, ono bonade fanyitege waha langa tere dada oruwanga ono-onoya waha ono wagu.

O baabo gane, tere Stefanas nomo gane isi nigiya. Nere waha, nere ila Akaia prowins langa yafade waha feiya nigidu bode amugedu Kristen heiganeha. Onodu nere nage nebere gauwou langa nere Itou nomo fai-aita hoyo nigei nomo haruwe taneha. Ji tere
fai onouha bagu, nere fai oruwanga hoyo nigidu bode haruwe onouha tetede waha nebere huuna langa yafagu ganga danga tafa tigini.
Stefanas wainga Fortunatus wainga Akaikus wainga nere ji bagu mayanenga ji nere nerigei nomo edega weneha, taate boni, tere oruwanga ji mai yeriyei nomo edo uwa,
onodu nere ji huwanyafe ono wanenga foinga inyai, tere tebere huwanyatege fere onounga. Tere fai onouha bonade edega wagu.

Nere sios Esia prowins langa tere kaiye tiganeha. Akwila wanga Prisila wanga sios nomo kristen fai-aita neire mata langa komo-komode waha bagu, nere Anyakaro unyi langa kaiyewou gai anyakaro tiganeha.
Nere baabo gane oruwanga kaiye tiganeha. Ere Itou nomo fai-aita ebere fanyige langa tere etenga-etenga oruwanga nere ila uumba nigagu.
Ji Pol we, ji yage yame owofe langa ji kaiyewou beha tere yerege tagini.
Fai ete no nomo huwanya Anyakaro tuwei nomo awei mata wonga, no edo inyaba wonbona. Anyakaro, ne mayau.
Anyakaro Yesus nomo aau warou no edo tere bagu inyonbona.
Yesus Kristus langa ji yame huwanyafe tere oruwanga tigini.
